requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. CMY bottle size should support >8K yield.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce user intervention and support high-volume printing requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle design, compatibility with NOA-F and IDS, and supply chain adjustments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles must pass yield tests demonstrating 6K Black and >8K CMY page output under standard conditions.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new NGB keyed bottles are designed for spill-free reliability during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink spills, reducing mess and potential product damage, enhancing user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must pass spill simulation tests with zero leakage in at least 99% of test cases.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label into the NOA-F, with no change to the click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and security of the ink delivery system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units must be produced with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, verified by QA inspection.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven components for reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All new units must function with current Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks without performance degradation.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Performance Characterization
requirements.Description: Conduct reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures long-term product reliability and performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive test reports for all parameters, with results meeting predefined reliability thresholds.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink degradation and maintains consistent print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to tank samples, ink formulations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling results demonstrate ink stability over the product’s intended lifecycle with no significant PQ impact.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Make NOA-F available as service parts for in-warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient field service and reduces downtime for customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Customer Support, Service Centers, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are listed in service catalogs and available for warranty claims.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology into the lid component.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product security, authentication, or performance (context-specific, assumed security/authentication).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Lid passes Acumen 6 functionality tests as specified in technical documentation.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA 14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and provision molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new components and configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines are updated and validated for new parts with successful pilot runs.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the product so that PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F are customer replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces service costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service Centers, Customer Support
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F following provided instructions without tools.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for durability and reduces TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers must pass accelerated life testing to 80K pages with no critical failures.

requirements.Title: Support for 25/20ppm Print Speed
requirements.Description: Product must support print speeds of 25ppm (pages per minute) for PDL and 20ppm for standard mode.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speeds are required to meet market demands.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers demonstrate 25ppm (PDL) and 20ppm (standard) speeds in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Provides protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests as per HP standards.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets environmental and regulatory standards, enabling market access.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Adjustments for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures usability and compactness despite larger tank size.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit seamlessly with tank and pass usability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interface and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4-Tube Ink Delivery Platform
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for a 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports reliable ink delivery and accommodates new tank configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink delivery system passes flow and reliability tests under all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Modify the service station for improved aerosol management due to tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink mist and maintains print quality and internal cleanliness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safe limits in all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes stress and dynamic motion tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life up to 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent operation and reliability over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes durability tests for 80K page cycles.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces TCO and supports extended product lifecycle.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance part replacement process is validated at service centers.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection in IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection in the Ink Delivery System (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and security of ink delivery.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS redesign, tank and bottle compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes connection reliability and security tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management for IDS to ensure optimal operation.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents air entrapment and startup failures, enhancing reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm passes reliability tests with zero startup failures in 99% of cases.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion definitions to align with increased page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer satisfaction and accurate yield claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics are defined and documented; product passes PQ tests at yield endpoints.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development costs and leverages proven electronics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes functional and reliability tests with reused components.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Provides modern wireless networking capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi passes connectivity and throughput benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Firmware Dune Integration
requirements.Description: Use Dune firmware in the product.
requirements.Rationale: Standardizes software stack and leverages existing capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all functional and regression firmware tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for HW & FW
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product security and protects against unauthorized access.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass penetration and vulnerability tests.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Expands product applicability to business and enterprise segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB and Enterprise Customers, IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solutions are functional and pass customer acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD drivers and clients.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes customer compatibility and ease of onboarding.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients are tested and certified for compatibility.

requirements.Title: Business Model Flexibility (Consumer, SMB, Enterprise)
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Increases market reach and adapts to evolving customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product and services are available and functional for all targeted business models.

requirements.Title: Onboarding and S&O Path Support
requirements.Description: Support onboarding through Consumer/HPX path, HP One path, SMB Portal path, and ECP path.
requirements.Rationale: Streamlines customer onboarding and setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All onboarding paths are tested and documented for smooth user experience.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures key component reliability and aligns with warranty/service intervals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing to 65K pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Product must support a warranty life of 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: Meets standard industry warranty expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product warranty is validated for 2 years under normal use conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box for easy serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service time and cost.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced or serviced in under 5 minutes by a trained technician.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Host support for 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K as flexible requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Allows future scalability and market adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product can be configured to support 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K if required.
